summary: The main preview now loads its Cairo integration correctly, displays external CUPS text literally, and uses a compact single-line document toolbar.
changelog: Registers PyGObject's Cairo foreign-type converter before the main drawing area receives a cairo.Context.
Adds python3-gi-cairo as a Debian dependency and to the source launcher preflight and installation documentation.
Displays CUPS job titles, printers, users, and update-manifest text literally instead of interpreting ampersands or angle brackets as Pango markup.
Places rotation, zoom, fit, actual size, and PDF page navigation in one compact line to preserve more vertical preview space.
Retains the 0.1.12 startup update-window centering correction.
Adds packaging contracts for the Cairo bridge and literal dynamic rows.
